class_prompts.bear_statue: gray stone bear statue or bear sculpture on a stone base; exclude trees, ground, plants, and platform
class_prompts.tree_trunk: large tree trunk or woody tree bark; exclude bear statue, branches on the ground, and green leaves
class_prompts.tree_canopy: tree leaves and green tree canopy above or behind the scene; exclude low plants, bushes, ground, and bear statue
class_prompts.ground_soil: bare dirt soil, mulch, gravel, or forest floor ground; exclude stone platform, bear statue, plants, and tree trunks
class_prompts.stone_platform: flat stone slab, concrete base, rock platform, or paved stone surface under or around the bear statue; exclude bear statue
class_prompts.low_green_plants: small green plants, ivy, weeds, grass, or groundcover near the ground; exclude tree canopy and bushes
class_prompts.bush_or_hedge: dense bush, hedge, shrub, or background vegetation; exclude tree trunks, bear statue, and groundcover
class_prompts.fallen_branch_or_root: fallen branch, exposed root, stick, or dead wood lying on the ground
class_prompts.wood_board: flat wooden board or plank lying on the ground
